plain_summary: The model does not reveal who was in its training data beyond chance level.
recommendation: Reduce overfitting (regularisation, fewer trees, early stopping) or train with differential privacy, then re-run this test.
summary: Loss-threshold attack (Yeom et al., 2018) on 3660 training and 3660 held-out rows: attack AUC 0.567 (limit 0.6), membership advantage 0.134. Mean loss 0.307 on training rows vs 0.493 on held-out rows. At a 1% false-positive rate the attack identifies 1.5% of training rows (5% FPR: 6.5%). The likelihood-ratio attack (offline LiRA, Carlini et al., 2022) with 8 shadow models on 2000 rows of each kind: AUC 0.594, identifying 5.2% of training rows at a 1% false-positive rate. The status uses the stronger of the two attacks.
title: Membership-inference risk
